Use case: stylized-concept. Create a COMPLETELY NEW ORIGINAL fantasy card illustration for ROYAL SHUFFLE in La Rata Remix. The title is contextual ONLY: absolutely NO text, lettering, title, numbers, UI, card frame, logos or watermark anywhere. Landscape4:3 ideally1448x1086. User explicitly rejected the earlier bright blue-and-gold cathedral concept and requests the CLASSIC BLACK AND GREEN La Rata look, darker and more sinister. Do not reuse or merely recolor that composition.

A sly crowned DARK GRAY RAT monarch in a near-BLACK royal cloak with a deep emerald lining shuffles a real deck of ancient ivory-black cards over a low obsidian table. Both naturally bent arms and connected paws are in front of the torso, performing a clear simple two-handed magical shuffle. The real deck splits, interlaces, then blooms into TWO distinct ghostly GREEN echoed decks hovering on either side of the rat's hands; the image suggests one deck magically multiplying during a royal shuffle. Abstract rat-crown marks on the cards, no writing. Keep cards readable as physical cards, not floating green rectangles or a computer interface.

Fresh camera: close three-quarter waist-up composition, the rat centered slightly to image right, leaning forward in a shadowed ruined sewer-throne alcove; its expressive pale muzzle, round pink ears and gleaming wary eyes clearly visible beneath a small tarnished gold crown with an emerald. Black cloth, charcoal stone and blue-black background dominate. Rich luminous poison/emerald GREEN magical ribbons connect the split decks and cast restrained green rim light on the paws and muzzle. Strong dark contour work, broad angular sculpted brush planes and textured hand-painted shadows in the established Slay the Spire2 / Venomous Encore card style. One subtle cold teal edge and tiny muted warm brass accents provide depth, but NO sunny gold cathedral, BLUE ROBES, white daylight, cheerful palace or overall fluorescent green wash. Dark doesn't mean illegible: face, paws, real deck and the two echoes read instantly at native card size. All essential anatomy and deck action within central80% crop safe area. No extra fingers, dislocated wrists, elaborate armor, additional characters or text.
